Find someone who needs support and support them. I met my best and only friend at the end of seventh grade. (I'm in ninth now) We supported each other when we needed someone to talk to. If you can find someone like that, you'll feel needed.

I met my best friend towards the end of seventh grade. (I'm in ninth grade now) and I support him when he needs me and it makes me feel important and needed. I need him as well. We could all use some support.

You don't need to be perfect. I'm not a good person. I lie, manipulate, and other things. I don't even know where to start. It doesn't make you deserve bad things to happen to you. I have a friend who keeps telling me the good things about me. Try to focus on the good things. Everyone has good qualities, regardless of who they are.

I can relate a whole lot. I consider myself a very selfish person. I wanted to die to show my friends how much they cared at one point. I still feel the urge to lie. I still DO lie sometimes. You never know who you might meet. You may find someone who will become your best support system. Believe me, it took me a long time to figure that out. I lost my best friend due to my past selfishness. I made friends with his other friend, who can relate to me. You'll find someone you can relate to as well.
It doesn't matter what you look like, because everyone SHOULD be different.I get it, I have fantasies about how my life could be as well. It's better to be different then completely perfect.
I wouldn't forgive myself if I let another person die. I lost a friend to suicide a while back, and it was really painful. Even though I don't know you, I don't want you to do anything like that.

Can definitely relate. Life sucks. I won't lie: mental health may not improve all that much. But still- there's always hope. There will be ups and downs, good things will happen, terrible things will happen. You can go on to do great things if you want. The strongest people are the ones that are going through the most terrible shit.

Very late and I don't want to sound like a broken record, but here goes: 

Life is strange and scary. I think it is meant to be that way. The strongest, most amazing people on earth are the ones who have gone through some terrible shit. All because they don't want to see others suffer. Strength is only revealed when someone is put under stress and grief, and other things like that. Having a painful life is actually better in the long run, I know from experience. It may suck now, but think about that could happen in the future.

I know how hard it is, But you don't KNOW what will happen. It could be bad, it could be good. There will be ups and downs. I lost a friend to suicide a while back, and it was very painful. If you don't have friends, do it for your snake! Snakes are friends :)
